name.description: Unique identifier for this adapter meta entry

description.description: Human-readable description of the agent or skill

model.description: Model identifier to use for this agent or skill

tools.description: List of tool names available to this agent or skill

can_spawn.description: Agent types this entry is permitted to spawn

spawn_section.description: Host-specific spawn call appended after the core skill body

skill.description: Name of the core skill file this entry wraps

invocation.description: How the skill is invoked on the target host (e.g. slash command or natural language prefix)

natural_language.description: Natural-language invocation string used on hosts that do not support slash commands (e.g. Codex)

wrapper.description: Optional wrapper template applied around the core skill body during stitching

strip_frontmatter.description: When true, the core file's YAML frontmatter is stripped before stitching

filename.description: Output filename override for the stitched file

host.description: Target host tool for this adapter entry

destination.description: Destination path (relative to the host config root) where the stitched file is written

files.description: List of additional files to deploy alongside the stitched output

variables.description: Key-value pairs substituted into the stitched file during materialization

templates.description: Template file mappings to deploy to the host's templates directory

skills.description: Sub-skill configuration block (destination, structure) for skill deployment

status.description: Deployment status marker used internally by the install CLI

structure.description: Deployment structure for skills: 'nested' (each skill in its own folder) or 'flat'

telemetry.description: When true, enables activity telemetry collection for this host adapter

inputs.description: Named input parameters the agent accepts, keyed by parameter name

description.description: Human-readable description of the input parameter

hooks.description: List of lifecycle hooks to install for this adapter

event.description: Hook event name that triggers the script

script.description: Shell command string to execute when the event fires
